capabilities: embed a one-week calendar below the built-in file explorer
open or create a date's daily note by clicking it
navigate to previous or next week and return to today
show ISO week numbers, rainbow date backgrounds, and daily-note status dots
follow the Daily Notes core plugin's folder, filename format, and template
extras: The README states the plugin has not yet been accepted into the Obsidian Community plugin directory and describes manual installation from GitHub releases; documentation is provided in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: Embeds directly below Obsidian's built-in file explorer—no separate calendar tab.
problem: Calendar plugins open in a separate sidebar tab, so the folder tree and calendar cannot be seen in the same sidebar view.

relations.evidence: The compact calendar presentation was inspired by Notebook Navigator, created by Johan Sanneblad.
Uses the folder, filename format, and template configured by Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin.

summary: Compact one-week calendar embedded below Obsidian's file explorer that opens or creates daily notes when a date is clicked.
